biggest_catch: Your friend must be 18 or older, register for the offer via your referral link or social post, open a new TruMark Financial checking account, and complete the offer requirements (at least 10 debit card transactions, excluding ATMs) within 60 days.
catches: Referrer earns a $50 Visa Reward card for each individual age 18 or older who registers for the offer, opens a new TruMark Financial checking account, and completes the offer requirements within the specified time.
The referred person must complete 10 or more debit card transactions (excluding ATM transactions) within 60 days of account opening.
A Referrer may receive up to ten (10) Visa Reward cards ($500 value) within a calendar year; only one Referrer may receive a card per Referred Person.
Referrer must be an existing member in good standing and must register for the program and share the offer with friends, family, or coworkers.
Reward cards may be reported as income to the IRS; taxes are the member's responsibility.
